title: Core Application Workflow
summary: This module orchestrates the main application logic, managing configuration, initializing data batches, and executing the data processing pipeline. It serves as the central control for the application's core operations.

nodes.label: Initiate Core Workflow
nodes.title: Start Application Workflow
nodes.description: The primary entry point for the entire application's core processing sequence, initiating all subsequent steps.

nodes.label: Load Application Configuration
nodes.title: Load Main Configuration
nodes.description: Retrieves essential configuration settings for the overall application from environment variables or other defined sources.

nodes.label: Validate Application Configuration
nodes.title: Validate Main Configuration
nodes.description: Checks the loaded application configuration for correctness and completeness, ensuring all required parameters are present and valid.

nodes.label: Environment Configuration Source
nodes.title: External Configuration Source
nodes.description: Represents the external source (e.g., environment variables) from which the application's configuration is loaded.

nodes.label: Initialize Data Batch
nodes.title: Create Initial Data Batch
nodes.description: Instantiates a new batch object, assigning it a unique identifier and preparing it for data population.

nodes.label: Add Sample Record to Batch
nodes.title: Populate Batch with Sample Data
nodes.description: Adds a new data record with a specific ID and payload to the currently active processing batch for demonstration or initial processing.

nodes.label: Execute Data Processing
nodes.title: Orchestrate Data Processing
nodes.description: The main function that orchestrates the data processing workflow, from configuration loading to batch execution and result reporting.

nodes.label: Load Processing Configuration
nodes.title: Load Processing-Specific Config
nodes.description: Retrieves essential configuration settings specifically for the data processing pipeline from the environment.

nodes.label: Initialize Processing Pipeline
nodes.title: Configure Data Pipeline
nodes.description: Sets up the data processing pipeline, configuring it with loaded settings to prepare for data transformation and analysis.

nodes.label: Generate Processing Batch
nodes.title: Construct Data Batch for Pipeline
nodes.description: Constructs a new batch of data records, populating it with items ready to be fed into the processing pipeline for execution.

nodes.label: Run Data Processing Pipeline
nodes.title: Execute Data Transformations
nodes.description: Executes the configured data processing pipeline on the prepared batch of records, performing all defined transformations and operations.

nodes.label: Report Processing Status
nodes.title: Report Processing Outcome
nodes.description: Reports the final status of the batch processing operation, indicating whether it completed successfully or encountered any issues.

groups.label: Workflow Orchestration
groups.title: Overall Workflow Control
groups.description: Components responsible for initiating the application's core workflow and orchestrating the execution of data processing tasks.

groups.label: Configuration Management
groups.title: Application Configuration Handling
groups.description: Manages the loading, validation, and provision of configuration settings required for both the main application and specific data processing steps.

groups.label: Data Batch Management
groups.title: Data Batch Creation & Preparation
groups.description: Handles the initialization, population, and generation of data batches, preparing them for subsequent processing by the pipeline.

groups.label: Data Processing Pipeline
groups.title: Core Data Transformation Logic
groups.description: Encapsulates the setup, execution, and reporting of the data processing pipeline, performing transformations and operations on data batches.
